subject: Althea pilot: payment structure, VAT routing, and credit cap
messages:
From: Sophie King <sophie.king@altheahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <aramos@altheahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing terms + VAT routing

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move into a 3-month pilot. Before we lock dates I need to confirm billing terms and VAT handling so our procurement team can issue a PO. Two asks from finance: 1) flexibility on net terms for the pilot (Net60 request because of internal cadence) or an alternative credit arrangement, and 2) if Redwood can route EU invoices to our Irish entity so VAT can be reverse-charged.

Attached is the SOW we shared internally (Althea_SOW_v1.pdf). Can you confirm what terms Redwood can offer for a pilot under $120k expected spend? Also include what evidence you need for VAT / entity routing.

Thanks,
Sophie King
Head of Ops, Althea Health
Sophie.King@altheahealth.com

Attachments: Althea_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie King <sophie.king@altheahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms + VAT routing

Hi Sophie — great to hear. Quick read-through of the SOW looks good. To keep the pilot moving while protecting both sides, finance and I discussed a hybrid approach we use for new mid-market pilots. Proposal below — happy to adjust based on your procurement constraints: 

- Kickoff prepay: 30% of total (invoice on execution)
- Milestone invoice: 50% after first integration milestone (typically ~30 days)
- Final reconciliation: remaining 20% on acceptance (net30 from invoice date)
- Monthly sweep: any overages billed monthly on Net30
- Credit cap: Redwood can extend a temporary credit corridor up to $150,000 for the pilot, conditional on a PO and signed SOW

For VAT routing: we can invoice from Redwood EU Ltd (Ireland) and include our Irish VAT ID. For reverse-charge we need: Althea Ireland Ltd VAT ID, billing address, and a contact for tax. If you prefer invoices from Redwood US, then VAT will be handled on your side and we’ll show gross amounts.

I’ve looped in Marissa (finance) and Olga (tax) to confirm the checklist / any KYC. Attached is a short payment schedule worksheet that shows dates and amounts if you want to circulate to procurement.

If Net60 is a hard requirement, we can discuss relaxing the prepay to 20% but would need either a corporate card on file, a PO that references the SOW, or an increased credit cap.

Would appreciate confirmation on which path you prefer.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-payment-schedule.xlsx
From: Sophie King <sophie.king@altheahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <aramos@altheahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms + VAT routing

Karthik — thanks for the clear options. Procurement pushed back on any upfront above 20% for pilot spend under $150k. Net60 is their preferred cadence but they can accept Net45 if we get the prepay down to 20%. Two clarifying questions:

1) For Redwood EU Ltd invoices — we will need a sample invoice that includes the Irish VAT ID fields and shows zero VAT / reverse-charge text to satisfy our tax team.
2) For the credit cap — if we confirm a PO at kickoff, is there a fast path to increase the cap to $200k after 30–60 days of on-time payments?

I’ve attached our VAT cert and the entity details (althea_vat_certificate.pdf). Our PO team prefers the PO reference included on every invoice.

Best,
Sophie

Attachments: althea_vat_certificate.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie King <sophie.king@altheahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms + VAT routing

Hi Sophie — Marissa from Finance here. Thanks for the VAT cert. We can accommodate the 20% prepay and Net45 milestone cadence with the following standard finance checklist: 

- Signed SOW (DocuSign link below)
- PO referencing the SOW and the HubSpot deal number (preferred)
- VAT certificate for Althea Ireland Ltd (received)
- Billing contact / billing@altheahealth.com for invoice routing
- KYC: for US entities we ask for W-9; for non-US we ask for local tax registry excerpt (you provided VAT cert which helps)

Operational notes: if the PO is present at kickoff we can set credit cap to $200,000 on a provisional basis; permanent increases follow a 90-day review of consumption and payments. We also can accept a corporate card on file to cover the prepay if that helps procurement. 

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/AAABBB-ALTHEA-SOW

If that checklist is OK I’ll ask billing ops to provision the invoice profile to Redwood EU Ltd for EU invoices and include the Althea PO reference on every invoice.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie King <sophie.king@altheahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing terms + VAT routing

Sophie — summarizing agreed terms so we have a single thread to hand to procurement / legal: 

- Total pilot not to exceed $150k initial budget.
- Payment schedule: 20% prepay on SOW signature, 50% on Milestone 1 (approx day 30), remaining 30% on acceptance invoiced Net45.
- Invoicing: Redwood will issue EU invoices from Redwood EU Ltd (Ireland) and include our VAT ID. Althea Ireland Ltd VAT ID will be included on the invoice and reverse-charge text will be present.
- PO: Please include the PO number on every invoice; with a valid PO at kickoff finance will provisionally increase credit cap to $200k.
- Evidence: Signed SOW (DocuSign link), PO, and VAT cert (received). Marissa / Olga will validate tax fields on a sample invoice and confirm.

Next step from your side: sign the SOW via DocuSign and provide the PO number. Once Marissa confirms the invoice profile we’ll send a sample PDF invoice for your tax team to validate.

I’ll hold off generating the kickoff invoice until I see the signed SOW / PO. Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Karthik
